Name: Remember Birthday Gifts
Author: zeldela
Description:
[size=2][i]This mod is compatible with version 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.4.0.  [/i]

[u]About this mod[/u][/size]
[b]
This mod acts like an automated "to-do" for birthday gift giving.[/b]
An icon will appear on your HUD when a villager has a birthday and disappear[i] [/i]after you've given them a gift. [size=3][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size]
[b][u][size=2]Instructions[/size]
[/u][/b]
1. Download [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file into your Mods folder 

[b][u]Configuration
[/u][/b]
Disable (true/false): whether to use the mod or not (default false).
NPCIcon (true/false): whether to use a gift icon or the villager's face (default false). 

[b][u]Support
[/u][/b]
This mod is [url=https://github.com/zeldela/sdv-mods/tree/main/sdv-mods/RememberBirthdays]open-source[/url]. 

[b][u]Future Plans[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Add compatibility with other mods so that you can lookup a villager's favorite gifts using the icon.
[*]Customize the location of the icon and/or the ability to move it around the screen. 
[/list]
